responsibilities: As Deputy/ Manager, Bus Procurement , you will play a key role in shaping Singapore's next-generation public bus fleet. By 2030, we will be replacing half of our 6,000-strong bus fleet with cutting-edge electric vehicles, and this role puts you in the forefront of this historic transition. Working at the intersection of engineering, policy, and sustainability, you will lead strategic bus procurement initiatives that directly influence fleet performance, passenger experience, and long-term asset resilience. Your work will take you beyond Singapore's borders as you scout emerging technologies and collaborate with global manufacturers to bring the most advanced solutions to our streets. You'll witness firsthand the latest innovations in electric propulsion, autonomous systems, and smart connectivity as you help modernise a fleet that's not just safe and reliable, but also future-ready. As the Deputy/ Manager, Bus Procurement , you will drive diverse and impactful responsibilities encompassing comprehensive end-to-end bus procurement and strategic asset management, including: 1. Drive Fleet Renewal and Replacement : Lead the charge in developing and executing strategies to renew and replace fleet to meet operational, safety, and sustainability objectives across the public bus network. 2. Tender Specifications & Evaluation : Lead in drafting new buses requirements, preparing tender specifications, and evaluating submissions to ensure the best value for the fleet. 3. Quality Assurance : Conduct pre-delivery inspections and testing of bus equipment to ensure they comply with contract specifications and operational standards. 4. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams : Coordinate with internal stakeholders (operations, engineering, policy, and system teams) to ensure seamless integration of bus systems and technologies onto the bus platform. 5. Partnership Management : Build and nurture strong relationships with overseas bus manufacturers and suppliers, staying informed on industry innovations and product developments. 6. Market Research & Design Specifications : Conduct in-depth research into emerging bus technologies and trends, making recommendations for design requirement to inform design improvements and future tender specifications. 7. Procurement Budget Oversight : Ensure cost-effective purchasing while maintaining high standards of quality, all within the boundaries of the procurement budget. Your work will directly support the advancement of Singapore's public bus fleet, enhance operational excellence and sustainability outcomes, and contribute to maintaining Singapore's position as a global leader in innovative and future-ready public transport solutions.

Working experience and knowledge of Government policies; functions and requirements of key Agencies and the regulatory framework for development projects. Strong in people management, good writing, communication and presentation skills. Detail-oriented and yet capable of macro analysis with good acumen in management and resolution of technical issues and challenges.
description: The position reports to the Lead / Senior Specialist is responsible for the planning, designing, and project management aligned with the NYP Campus Masterplan and Campus Rejuvenation projects. The scope of works includes end-to-end management of the project from inception, procurement of services and works, construction, handover, to post-construction activities. You will contribute to creating an eco-friendly, innovative, and inclusive environment that enhances the overall campus experience.

Tender Specifications & Evaluation : Lead in drafting new buses requirements, preparing tender specifications, and evaluating submissions to ensure the best value for the fleet. 3. Market Research & Design Specifications : Conduct in-depth research into emerging bus technologies and trends, making recommendations for design requirement to inform design improvements and future tender specifications. 7. Procurement Budget Oversight : Ensure cost-effective purchasing while maintaining high standards of quality, all within the boundaries of the procurement budget. Your work will directly support the advancement of Singapore's public bus fleet, enhance operational excellence and sustainability outcomes, and contribute to maintaining Singapore's position as a global leader in innovative and future-ready public transport solutions.

responsibilities: As Manager, Bus Procurement , you will play a key role in shaping Singapore's next-generation public bus fleet. By 2030, we will be replacing half of our 6,000-strong bus fleet with cutting-edge electric vehicles, and this role puts you in the forefront of this historic transition. Working at the intersection of engineering, policy, and sustainability, you will lead strategic bus procurement initiatives that directly influence fleet performance, passenger experience, and long-term asset resilience. Your work will take you beyond Singapore's borders as you scout emerging technologies and collaborate with global manufacturers to bring the most advanced solutions to our streets. You'll witness firsthand the latest innovations in electric propulsion, autonomous systems, and smart connectivity as you help modernise a fleet that's not just safe and reliable, but also future-ready. As the Manager, Bus Procurement , you will drive diverse and impactful responsibilities encompassing comprehensive end-to-end bus procurement and strategic asset management, including: 1. Drive Fleet Renewal and Replacement : Lead the charge in developing and executing strategies to renew and replace fleet to meet operational, safety, and sustainability objectives across the public bus network. 2. Tender Specifications & Evaluation : Lead in drafting new buses requirements, preparing tender specifications, and evaluating submissions to ensure the best value for the fleet. 3. Quality Assurance : Conduct pre-delivery inspections and testing of bus equipment to ensure they comply with contract specifications and operational standards. 4. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams : Coordinate with internal stakeholders (operations, engineering, policy, and system teams) to ensure seamless integration of bus systems and technologies onto the bus platform. 5. Partnership Management : Build and nurture strong relationships with overseas bus manufacturers and suppliers, staying informed on industry innovations and product developments. 6. Market Research & Design Specifications : Conduct in-depth research into emerging bus technologies and trends, making recommendations for design requirement to inform design improvements and future tender specifications. 7. Procurement Budget Oversight : Ensure cost-effective purchasing while maintaining high standards of quality, all within the boundaries of the procurement budget. Your work will directly support the advancement of Singapore's public bus fleet, enhance operational excellence and sustainability outcomes, and contribute to maintaining Singapore's position as a global leader in innovative and future-ready public transport solutions.

responsibilities: Reporting to the Senior Manager, you will lead a team of executives and service contractors for the management of buildings/facilities maintenance to support Authority's operations across multiple premises. As owner of all related systems, you will be responsible for site inspections, cost analysis, budgeting, preparing work quotations/tender specifications, procurement of services, attending to feedback and ad-hoc decisions. You will constantly review work processes and procedures to enhance facilities operations, adopt good industry practices, and ensure compliance with government regulations. Your roles include: Integrated Facilities Management: Oversee facilities management operations including housekeeping with oversight of security operations across HQ and satellite offices through our IFMS Operations Command Centre (OCC). Technical Systems Management: Monitor and maintain all electrical and mechanical systems including chilled water systems, VRV and DX systems, High-Tension and Low-Tension electrical systems. Perform data analysis on real-time data from IoT sensors, OCC dashboards, and smart energy meters. Prepare/present monthly progress of Smart FM and utilities utilisation reports to Senior Management. Sustainability & Energy Management: Identify utilities wastage, monitor waste management, recommend improvements, and develop policies for Smart FM and energy management to meet WOG and Authority’s Green Plan targets, including reporting efforts. Innovation & Smart Technologies:Manage implementation of new initiatives including smart FM technologies, sensors and IoT devices. Manage customer service-oriented support services including concierge services and logistic support for offices and events. Contract & Vendor Management: Review, manage and supervise term contracts to ensure performance, meeting KPIs/SLAs, compliance, and timely renewals across all premises. Ensure day to day safe, effective, smooth, uninterrupted operations of LTA’s premises with quality service levels and timely closure of all maintenance and logistics requests, feedbacks. To ensure high availability of all equipment/systems/services/premises. Compliance & Safety: Ensure regulatory compliance, safety standards, and uninterrupted operations at all facilities. Manage emergency operations and other duties as assigned to meet organisational objectives, including specifications review/input for new build/improvement projects concerning facility management and operations. Relocation Management: Manage phased transition of existing offices and taking over new offices and manage reinstatement and return of existing premises to landlords.

responsibilities: As Manager, Bus Procurement , you will play a key role in shaping Singapore's next-generation public bus fleet. By 2030, we will be replacing half of our 6,000-strong bus fleet with cutting-edge electric vehicles, and this role puts you in the forefront of this historic transition. Working at the intersection of engineering, policy, and sustainability, you will lead strategic bus procurement initiatives that directly influence fleet performance, passenger experience, and long-term asset resilience. Your work will take you beyond Singapore's borders as you scout emerging technologies and collaborate with global manufacturers to bring the most advanced solutions to our streets. You'll witness firsthand the latest innovations in electric propulsion, autonomous systems, and smart connectivity as you help modernise a fleet that's not just safe and reliable, but also future-ready. As the Manager, Bus Procurement , you will drive diverse and impactful responsibilities encompassing comprehensive end-to-end bus procurement and strategic asset management, including: 1. Drive Fleet Renewal and Replacement : Lead the charge in developing and executing strategies to renew and replace fleet to meet operational, safety, and sustainability objectives across the public bus network. 2. Tender Specifications & Evaluation : Lead in drafting new buses requirements, preparing tender specifications, and evaluating submissions to ensure the best value for the fleet. 3. Quality Assurance : Conduct pre-delivery inspections and testing of bus equipment to ensure they comply with contract specifications and operational standards. 4. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams : Coordinate with internal stakeholders (operations, engineering, policy, and system teams) to ensure seamless integration of bus systems and technologies onto the bus platform. 5. Partnership Management : Build and nurture strong relationships with overseas bus manufacturers and suppliers, staying informed on industry innovations and product developments. 6. Market Research & Design Specifications : Conduct in-depth research into emerging bus technologies and trends, making recommendations for design requirement to inform design improvements and future tender specifications. 7. Procurement Budget Oversight : Ensure cost-effective purchasing while maintaining high standards of quality, all within the boundaries of the procurement budget. Your work will directly support the advancement of Singapore's public bus fleet, enhance operational excellence and sustainability outcomes, and contribute to maintaining Singapore's position as a global leader in innovative and future-ready public transport solutions.
